sources.massKg: TUNING KNOB (climb) — 8500 kg combat weight (F-5E empty ~4.35 t, MTOW ~11.2 t). With the book-sourced thrust gives T/W ~0.37 dry / ~0.54 wet and a burner best-climb of ~20900 fpm at 10000 ft (dry ~11700 fpm), in the credible band below the published ~34500 fpm sea-level initial rate. Confirmed by the burner-climb envelope test (> 5000 fpm, wet > dry). Phase B source verification pending (CLAUDE.md).
sources.cl0: TUNING KNOB — low-AR fighter zero-AoA lift; small on a thin symmetric-ish wing.
sources.clAlphaPerRad: TUNING KNOB — 3.5/rad, a low-AR (3.83) lift slope (below the 2*pi/high-AR value). With stallAlphaRad gives CLmax_clean = 0.05 + 3.5*0.35 = 1.275.
sources.stallAlphaRad: TUNING KNOB — 20 deg (0.35 rad) clean critical AoA for a fighter wing.
sources.postStallDecayRad: TUNING KNOB — 0.25 rad fade width past the break.
sources.cd0: TUNING KNOB (climb) — 0.020 clean parasite drag; the subsonic value only (no wave drag; the sim never runs supersonic, spec §1/§7). Pinned with maxPowerW by the burner-climb test.
sources.gearDragCd0: TUNING KNOB — 0.025, a fighter gear/doors drag increment above the 737's (smaller aircraft, proportionally higher CD0 impact). Phase B source verification pending (CLAUDE.md). Pinned by the Task 3 broken-arm test.
sources.speedbrakeCd0: TUNING KNOB (#51) — 0.06, the F-5E ventral airbrake drag increment (~3x clean cd0 0.02). Lets the fighter manage a steep idle descent without instant overspeed. Pinned by the speedbrake envelope test. Source verification pending (CLAUDE.md).
sources.oswaldE: TUNING KNOB — 0.70, lower span efficiency for a low-AR fighter wing.
sources.rollRateMaxRadS: TUNING KNOB — 3.5 rad/s (~200 deg/s), the nimble fighter roll rate (decisions B-007). Far above the 737's 15 deg/s.
sources.damping/stiffness: TUNING KNOBS (decisions B-007) — no published derivatives; response constants are named knobs. High rates with firm damping give a crisp fighter feel.
sources.refDynamicPressurePa: TUNING KNOB — 8000 Pa; raised above the 737's 6000 Pa so control authority is available across the high fighter speed band.
sources.trimAlphaCenterRad: TUNING KNOB — ~1.1 deg, near a fighter cruise AoA.
sources.maxPowerW / propPeakSpeedMs / afterburne: SOURCED to J85-GE-21 book static thrust (AF-004b) — 2x J85-GE-21: 3,500 lbf (15.6 kN) dry / 5,000 lbf (22.2 kN) wet per engine => 31.2 kN dry / 44.4 kN wet total. Expressed through the shared power-limited-prop formula T = eta*P/max(V,propPeakSpeedMs): propPeakSpeedMs 320 m/s sits above the fighter's max sustained TAS so dry thrust is modeled CONSTANT with speed at the book static value (T = eta*P/320 = 0.85*11.75e6/320 = 31.2 kN full-throttle dry; wet = *afterburnerFactor 1.43 = 44.6 kN). Modeling thrust constant = static value across the band is the same documented simplification as the b738 (a constant-thrust prop formula cannot also track ram/speed effects). Gives a realistic T/W ~0.37 dry / ~0.54 wet at 8.5 t. maxPowerW is a fictitious 'power', NOT shaft power (a turbojet has no propeller). Confirmed by the burner-climb envelope test. Phase B source verification pending (CLAUDE.md).
sources.propEfficiency: 0.85 — the eta in T = eta*P/max(V,peak); one factor of the fictitious eta*P product, kept near 1 so maxPowerW carries the tuning.
sources.lapseModel: "turbofan" — the near-flat-rated J85 is closest to the shared turbofan curve (flat to TURBOFAN_CORNER_M, then density falloff); selected by this key, not a class branch. Shared with the 737 (decisions AF-002); the F-5E envelope runs entirely below the corner so the shared corner is inert here.
sources.afterburnerFactor: 1.43 — J85-GE-21 wet/dry static thrust ratio (5,000 lbf wet / 3,500 lbf dry = 1.43; decisions AF-004b). Drives the shared dry/wet toggle (Task 3), not a fighter-only code path.
sources.limits.vneIasMs: TUNING KNOB — 360 m/s subsonic-capped operating IAS placard (display only; the sim caps at Mmo 0.95 before this IAS is reached). Spec §1/§7: the model has no wave drag so it never runs where a supersonic Vne would lie.
sources.limits.vnoIasMs: TUNING KNOB — 320 m/s caution reference below vne (display only).
sources.limits.vfeIasMs: TUNING KNOB — 130 m/s flap-extend placard (display only).
sources.vleIasMs: 240 KIAS = 123.5 m/s — F-5E gear limit speed (spec target ~240 kt). Phase B source verification pending.
sources.gLimits: +7.33 / -3.0 — F-5E design load factors (fighter clean-envelope limits).
sources.serviceCeilingM: TUNING KNOB — ~51500 ft (15700 m). Above the shared turbofan corner (FL380) but not exercised by any envelope test (airborne-spawn sim; no ceiling-hang test). Phase B source verification pending (CLAUDE.md).
sources.mmo: 0.95 — capped subsonic (spec §7): the model has no wave-drag physics, so the Mach annunciator trips here. Supersonic + wave drag deferred to issue #2 (decisions AF-005).
sources.flaps: 0 / maneuvering (MNVR) / full — F-5E flap positions. dCL0/dStallAlpha/dCD0 are TUNING KNOBS.
sources.display: ASI face 80-800 kt spans the fighter band; attitudeStyle ball (full horizon disc).
sources.gear: retractable — the F-5E has retractable gear.
sources.lookArc: // tunable — fighter family (issue #44 follow-up): bubble canopy, near-unrestricted visibility — wide yaw (almost over-the-shoulder), high pitch-up (canopy bow barely intrudes), still floor/panel-limited looking down.
